data.name: MI2_001
data.value: ...What's that?[pause=0] Y'all live in the guild?

data.name: MI2_002
data.value: Well,[pause=10] y'all still welcome here anytime ya like![pause=0] Don't be a stranger!

data.name: MI2_003
data.value: Always a shame to hear somethin' like this happenin' to townsfolk.

data.name: MI2_004
data.value: Me and the missus need to pay her a visit later to see how she's holdin' up.

data.name: MI2_005
data.value: He's a real catch,[pause=10] ain't he![pause=0] I'm real proud of him and our two kids!

data.name: MI2_006
data.value: We're keepin' a close eye on our young'uns until he's returned safely,[pause=10] just in case somethin' dangerous's afoot.

data.name: MI2_007
data.value: Just cause some dumb brat runs off doesn't mean I'm going to![pause=0] But of course my parents don't get that!

data.name: MI2_008
data.value: UGH![pause=0] This is so annoying![pause=0] And they're so annoying too!

data.name: MI2_009
data.value: I've heard great things about the Metano Inn from others in my travels.[pause=0] I hope they were right!

data.name: MI2_010
data.value: The continental breakfast leaves much to be desired though...[pause=0] These portions are way too little!

data.name: MI3_001
data.value: ...Nyuh?[pause=40]

data.name: MI3_002
data.value: I'm hopin' to teach 'er some of the skills of the trade by sittin' up here wit' me!

data.name: MI3_003
data.value: Guess I don't need to be worryin' 'bout no danger comin' to my youngsters then!

data.name: MI3_004
data.value: ...Whatever.

data.name: MI3_005
data.value: As nice as it is,[pause=10] I'd prefer if we were out getting work done instead of lollygagging like {0} there wants to.

data.name: MI3_006
data.value: Suppose that's what a professional like me gets for parterning up with a layabout like him.

data.name: MI3_007
data.value: Sssso {0} and I are sssstaying in this inn while we hunt bountiessss around here.

data.name: MI3_008
data.value: Though he issss too keen to sssstay here at the inn,[pause=10] rather than go out and do our jobssss.

data.name: MI3_009
data.value: He issss jusssst not a hard-worker like I am.

data.name: MI4_001
data.value: I don't want to pay an extra fee if I left a mark on the bed by accident...

data.name: MI4_002
data.value: I don't want to work in this dumb inn![pause=0] But they don't get that,[pause=10] of course not!

data.name: MI4_004
data.value: ...Eeeuuuwaawu?

data.name: MI4_005
data.value: He shoulda said his first word by now...[pause=0] I'm hopin' he'll say his first real soon!

data.name: MI4_006
data.value: I reckon less Pokémon are on the roads what with the mystery dungeons and outlaws 'n all...

data.name: MI5_002

data.name: MI6_001
data.value: Three famous names in town and suddenly every room's booked solid.[pause=0] Funny how that works.

data.name: MI6_002
data.value: Not that I'm complaining.[pause=0] Business is business.

data.name: MI6_003
data.value: Dottir keeps sneaking off to watch the street whenever those three walk by.[pause=0] I've had to call her back twice today.

data.name: MI6_004
data.value: I don't mind admiration.[pause=0] I mind unmade beds.

data.name: MI6_005
data.value: A missing child found safe![pause=0] That's the kind of business I like hearing about, over the paying kind.

data.name: MI6_006
data.value: You brought that little one home.[pause=0] Dottir hasn't stopped talking about it. Neither have I, honestly.

data.name: MI6_007
data.value: I saw them from the window![pause=0] They walked right past our door!

data.name: MI6_008
data.value: Dad called me back to sweep the hallway right in the middle of it.[pause=0] Worst timing ever.

data.name: MI6_009
data.value: You found that little bug and brought it home![pause=0] That's way more impressive than three ladies just walking by.
